meta.title: Create a department budget with categories and submit it for approval
gaps: Open Budget Management and click New
Fill Department Name, Period Type, and Fiscal Year Range
Assign participant teams from dropdown lists
Create a budget category with Category Name, Budget Allocated, and Budget Spent
Submit the budget and review the Approval Workflow preview
Assert the Approval Note contains the budget details and workflow
Assert the approved budget appears in the Budget Department List
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Open Budget Management and click New; Fill Department Name, Period Type, and Fiscal Year Range; Assign participant teams from dropdown lists; Create a budget category with Category Name, Budget Allocated, and Budget Spent; Submit the budget and review the Approval Workflow preview; Submit the approval workflow; Assert the Approval Note contains the budget details and workflow; Assert the approved budget appears in the Budget Department List

args.need: open Budget Management, create the department budget with its period, fiscal year range, participant teams and category values, submit it, review and submit the approval workflow, and leave the resulting Approval Note visible

steps.note: The catalog cannot navigate to or operate any Budget Management, budget category, or approval workflow controls.
Checks for the expected approval-note label after the tester completes the unavailable workflow.
